_about: T5 owns this artifact (plan.md, task T5). S05's Given says 'device A is the shape the
shipped source ordering ranks last and device B is the shape it ranks first'. The frozen
spec does not say ranks last AMONG WHAT, and the answer changes the scenario: taken over
every CaptureSourceCategory the last is phoneMic, which is the handset's own microphone
and not a device that can be remembered, substituted for, or handed off to at all.
The reading recorded here is 'last among the REMEMBERABLE EXTERNAL devices'. It is
written down rather than argued in a comment so the scenario FAILS if the shipped
ordering changes underneath it, instead of quietly testing a different pair of shapes.

why: The handset's own built-in microphone. It is not discovered, not paired, not
detachable, and cannot be the subject of 'another device substitutes' — every
handset has exactly one and it is always present. Reading S05's 'ranks last' as
phoneMic would make device A the phone, and the scenario would prove nothing about

deviceA.why: last among the rememberable external devices

deviceB.why: first — and the vendor-shaped one, which is the point: it must not win
